title: Big Hero 6
description: A young robotics genius and his inflatable robot join a team of heroes to protect their city.
overview: After a personal tragedy, Hiro discovers a dangerous mystery and teams up with Baymax and his friends to uncover the truth.

title: Dolphin Tale
description: A boy helps an injured dolphin recover and return to the water.
overview: Inspired by a true story, a young boy and a team of rescuers work together to help a dolphin named Winter.

title: E.T. the Extra-Terrestrial
description: A young boy befriends an alien who is stranded on Earth.
overview: Elliott tries to protect his unusual new friend and help him find a way back home.

title: Hugo
description: An orphan living in a Paris railway station discovers a mysterious mechanical secret.
overview: Hugo's search for answers leads him to an unexpected adventure involving an automaton and a forgotten filmmaker.

title: Klaus
description: A postman and a mysterious toymaker bring kindness to a divided town.
overview: Sent to a remote town, Jesper forms an unexpected friendship with Klaus that changes the community.

title: Meet the Robinsons
description: A young inventor travels into the future and meets an unusual family.
overview: Lewis discovers that his inventions can lead to unexpected adventures and learns the importance of moving forward.

title: Paddington
description: A polite bear travels to London and finds a new home with a human family.
overview: Paddington's search for a home leads to funny adventures and unexpected challenges with the Brown family.

title: The Adventures of Tintin
description: A young reporter discovers a secret connected to a mysterious ship.
overview: Tintin and Captain Haddock travel around the world to uncover a hidden treasure and solve an old mystery.

title: The Tale of Despereaux
description: A brave little mouse dreams of becoming a hero.
overview: Despereaux sets out on a journey involving friendship, courage, and a princess in need of help.

title: The Black Stallion
description: A boy and a wild horse form a strong bond after being stranded on an island.
overview: After returning home, Alec works with a horse trainer to prepare the black stallion for racing.

title: The Iron Giant
description: A young boy befriends a giant robot that falls from space.
overview: As fear spreads through his town, Hogarth tries to protect his giant friend and show others who he really is.

title: The Journey of Natty Gann
description: A young girl travels across America to find her father.
overview: During the Great Depression, Natty sets out on a difficult journey and forms an unexpected bond with a wolf.

title: The Secret Garden
description: A lonely girl discovers a hidden garden at her uncle's estate.
overview: Mary's discovery of a secret garden helps her build friendships and brings new life to the people around her.

title: The Shaggy Dog
description: A busy lawyer experiences a strange transformation into a dog.
overview: After a mysterious incident, Dave begins to see his family life differently and investigates the cause of his transformation.

title: The Golden Compass
description: A young girl sets out on a dangerous journey in a mysterious parallel world.
overview: Lyra travels north to rescue missing children and uncovers secrets that could change her world.

title: WALL-E
description: A small waste-collecting robot discovers a new purpose while exploring space.
overview: WALL-E meets EVE and embarks on an adventure that could change the future of humanity.
